cases.name: Karina Castro
cases.about: She attended Menlo-Atherton High School, got her GED, and worked as a Door Dash driver.
cases.narrative: He beheaded her with a samurai sword outside her Bay Area home in broad daylight. According to witnesses, he was seen repeatedly “slashing” at the mother of his child several times until her head had almost completely come off. “The head was underneath the car and she was laying in the back of the car — just severed,” neighbor Chapel Thorborne told KGO-TV last year. “And they covered her up.” She tried to run during the attack — but Solano was determined. He struck her at least seven times. One witness who testified reportedly said he saw Solano “swing at Castro with such a blow, her arm was almost severed from her body.”
